title:
Land at $1,537.
*Launch at $2,900?*

lines.say: You're waiting for new condo prices to drop. Here's what developers just paid for land.
lines.cap: waiting for a drop? *look at land*

lines.say: On 1 September 2026, a Bedok site at New Upper Changi Road drew a top bid of 1,537 dollars per square foot.
That's land only. Construction, financing and profit come on top.
Analysts expect the project to launch at about 2,850 to 3,200 dollars per square foot.
Nearby, Sky Eden at Bedok launched at about 2,100 a few years ago.
When land costs rise, future launches nearby are often priced higher too.
Most people decide this wrongly. Comment WHY to see the mistake.

caption:
Waiting for new condo prices to drop? Look at what developers just paid for land. 🏗️

On 1 Sep 2026, a Bedok site at New Upper Changi Road drew a top bid of $1,537 psf ppr. That's land only: construction, financing and profit come on top.

Analysts expect a launch at about $2,850 to $3,200 psf. Nearby, Sky Eden@Bedok launched at about $2,100 a few years ago.

When land costs rise, future launches nearby are often priced higher too.

Most people decide this wrongly. Comment WHY to see the mistake 👇

Analyst estimates, not confirmed prices.
